δαέρων: δαήρ — husband’s brother, brother-in-law; masc. gen. pl. (stem δαερ-), partitive after a superlative (’of all the brothers-in-law’) or in a list of relatives (’of brothers-in-law’)
δείσητ: δείδω — fear, dread; aor. subj. 2 pl., elided (δείσητ’ = δείσητε), in a prohibition after μή: ’do not fear’
διέστησαν: διίστημι — set apart; intrans. aor. stand apart; aor. 3 pl. act. (strong aorist, διέστησαν): ’stood apart, made way’
δωδεκάτη: δωδέκατος — twelfth; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἠώς: ’the twelfth (dawn)’
εἰκοστὸν: εἰκοστός — twentieth; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ἔτος: ’the twentieth (year)’
εἰσάγαγον: εἰσάγω — lead in, bring in; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic εἰσήγαγον)
εἴξατέ: εἴκω — give way, yield; aor. imper. 2 pl., accented before the enclitic μοι: ’give way!’
εἶξαν: εἴκω — give way, yield; aor. 3 pl., + dat.: ’gave way (to)’
εἶπες: εἶπον (aor. of λέγω/φημί) — say, speak; aor. 2 sg.: ’you said’ (augment fused into the diphthong, unlike unfused ἔειπες)
εὐπέπλων: εὔπεπλος — fair-robed, with beautiful robes; fem. gen. pl.
ζεύγνυσαν: ζεύγνυμι — yoke, harness; impf. 3 pl. in -σαν, unaugmented (= Attic ἔζευγνυσαν): ’they yoked’
ζωός: ζωός — alive, living (epic and Ionic for Attic ζῶν); masc. nom. sg.: ’living’
θρήνων: θρῆνος — dirge, lament sung over the dead; masc. gen. pl., dependent on ἐξάρχους: ’of dirges’
θῆκαν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔθηκαν)
κήδοντο: κήδω — trouble; mid. care for, be concerned for (+ gen.); impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’they cared for’
καλύψαντες: καλύπτω — cover, wrap; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having covered, wrapped’
κατέρυκες: κατερύκω — hold back, restrain, check; impf. 2 sg. act.: ’you were holding back’
κατείβετο: κατείβω — let flow down; mid. flow away, ebb; impf. mid. 3 sg.: ’was flowing down’
κατεστόρεσαν: καταστορέννυμι — spread over, cover over; aor. 3 pl. act., epic στορ- (= Attic κατέστρωσαν): ’they covered over’
κεδνὰς: κεδνός — careful, trusty, dear; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with ἀλόχους
κλαυθμοῖο: κλαυθμός — weeping, wailing; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ), partitive after ἄσεσθε: ’of weeping’
κλυτοῦ: κλυτός — famous, renowned; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with a name: ’renowned’
λάεσσι: λᾶας — stone; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic λίθοις)
λάρνακα: λάρναξ — chest, coffer; fem. acc. sg.
λελείψεται: λείπω — leave; pass. be left, remain; fut. perf. 3 sg. mid.-pass., with a neut. pl. subject: ’will be left, will remain’
μεμνῄμην: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. remember (+ gen.); perf. opt. 1 sg. mid. with present sense, with κεν, potential: ’I would remember’
μόλῃ: βλώσκω — go, come; aor. subj. 3 sg. (strong aorist ἔμολον), without κεν, after πρίν: ’until … comes’
οὐρεῦσι: οὐρεύς — mule; masc. dat. pl. (nom. pl. οὐρῆες): ’for the mules’
πέμπων: πέμπω — send, dispatch; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’sending’
πέπλοισι: πέπλος — robe, cloth; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): ’with robes’
πέρνασχ: πέρνημι — sell (abroad); iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκ-, unaugmented, elided (πέρνασχ’ = πέρνασκε, κ > χ before a rough breathing): ’used to sell’
πέρσεται: πέρθω — sack, destroy; fut. 3 sg. mid. with passive sense: ’will be sacked’
παραιφάμενος: παράφημι — talk over, coax; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg. (παραιφάμενος): ’coaxing, winning over with words’
πεφρίκασιν: φρίσσω — bristle, shudder; perf. 3 pl. πεφρίκασι(ν) with present sense, + acc.: ’bristle with fear at, shrink from’
πημανέειν: πημαίνω — do harm to, afflict; fut. inf. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic πημανεῖν), after ἐπέτελλε: ’to do harm’
πορφυρέοις: πορφύρεος — purple, dark red; masc. dat. pl. (= Attic πορφυροῖς), agreeing with πέπλοισι
πρόσφατος: πρόσφατος — fresh, new; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’fresh’
πτόλεϊ: πτόλις — city (epic by-form of πόλις); fem. dat. sg. πτόλεϊ (= Attic πόλει)
πυκνοῖσιν: πυκνός — thick, close-packed; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς), agreeing with λάεσσι: ’solid’
στονόεσσαν: στονόεις — groan-causing, mournful; fem. acc. sg., epic -εσσα (= Attic -εισα)
συναγειρόμενοι: συναγείρω — gather together; mid. assemble; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’gathering together’
τεὸς: τεός — your, yours; epic (= Attic σός); masc. nom. sg.
τιλλέσθην: τίλλω — pluck, tear; mid. tear one’s own (hair); impf. 3 dual mid., unaugmented: ’the two tore’
τρητοῖς: τρητός — bored, pierced (with holes for cords); masc./neut. dat. pl.
φίλτατε: φίλτατος — dearest, most dear (superl. of φίλος); masc. voc. sg., with a partitive gen.: ’dearest of all’
φαεσίμβροτος: φαεσίμβροτος — giving light to mortals (φάος ’light’ + βροτός); two-ending adj., fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
ἀΐξασαι: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. part. act. fem. nom. pl.: ’darting, rushing’
ἀγάγωμι: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. subj. 1 sg., epic -μι (= Attic ἀγάγω), after ἐπήν: ’when I have led’
ἀγίνεον: ἀγινέω — lead, bring (by-form of ἄγω); impf. 3 pl., uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἠγίνουν): ’were bringing’
ἀγανοφροσύνῃ: ἀγανοφροσύνη — gentleness of mind, kindliness (ἀγανός + φρήν); fem. dat. sg., of means: ’by gentleness of mind’
ἀγανοῖσι: ἀγανός — gentle, kindly, soothing; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), agreeing with βέλεσσιν: ’gentle (shafts)’
ἀθλεύων: ἀθλεύω — toil, labour (ἆθλος ’contest, toil’); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’toiling, labouring’
ἀμάξῃσιν: ἄμαξα — wagon, cart; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
ἀμειλίχου: ἀμείλιχος — ungentle, harsh (ἀ- + μείλιχος); masc. gen. sg., agreeing with ἄνακτος
ἀμιχθαλόεσσαν: ἀμιχθαλόεις — misty (meaning uncertain; traditional gloss); fem. acc. sg., epic -εσσα (= Attic -εισα)
ἀμφίεπον: ἀμφιέπω — busy oneself about, be busy with; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they busied themselves about’
ἀμφίσταθ: ἀμφίσταμαι — stand around; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (ἀμφίσταθ’ = ἀμφίστατο, τ > θ before a rough breathing): ’stood around’
ἀνέστησεν: ἀνίστημι — set up, raise; aor. 3 sg. act. (transitive first aorist), ν-movable: ’raised up’
ἀοιδοὺς: ἀοιδός — singer, minstrel; masc. acc. pl.
ἀπήνῃ: ἀπήνη — mule-wagon, cart; fem. dat. sg.
ἀπελήλυθα: ἀπέρχομαι — go away, depart; perf. 1 sg. (stem ἐληλυθ-) with present force: ’I have gone away’
ἀχνυμένη: ἄχνυμαι — be grieved, sorrow; pres. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’grieving’
ἁπτόμεναι: ἅπτω — fasten; mid. touch, lay hold of (+ gen.); pres. part. mid. fem. nom. pl.: ’laying hold of’
ἄσεσθε: ἄω — satiate; mid. take one’s fill of (+ gen.); 2 pl. mid. with future sense (epic short-vowel -σ-; a short-vowel aor. subj. is also possible): ’you shall have your fill’
ἆνερ: ἀνήρ — man, husband; masc. voc. sg., ἆνερ = ὦ ἄνερ (crasis): ’husband!’
ἐθρήνεον: θρηνέω — sing a dirge, lament; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἐθρήνουν): ’they sang dirges’
ἐνίπτοι: ἐνίπτω — rebuke, reproach; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., in a condition after εἰ: ’if … should rebuke’
ἐξάρχους: ἔξαρχος — leader, one who leads off (+ gen.); masc. acc. pl.: ’leaders-off’
ἐργάζοιο: ἐργάζομαι — work, do; pres. opt. 2 sg. mid.-dep., with κεν in a relative clause, potential: ’you would do’
ἐφορμηθεῖεν: ἐφορμάω — set on; pass. rush upon; aor. pass.-dep. opt. 3 pl., in a clause of apprehension after μή: ’lest they rush upon’
ἑκυρή: ἑκυρά (Ionic ἑκυρή) — mother-in-law, husband’s mother; fem. nom. sg.
ἑκυρὸς: ἑκυρός — father-in-law, husband’s father; masc. nom. sg.
ἑρσήεις: ἑρσήεις — dewy (ἕρση ’dew’), fresh; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dewy, fresh’
ἔβην: βαίνω — go, step; aor. 1 sg.: ’I went’
ἕλεσκε: αἱρέω — take, seize; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε-, unaugmented: ’would take’
ἕταροί: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl., epic by-form (= ἑταῖροι); accented before an enclitic
ἕψεαι: ἕπομαι — follow, go with; fut. 2 sg. mid.-dep., epic uncontracted -εαι (= Attic ἕψῃ): ’you will follow’
ἴμβρον: Ἴμβρος — Imbros, island in the northern Aegean; fem. acc. sg., goal of motion after ἐς: ’to Imbros’
ὀδύροντο: ὀδύρομαι — lament, wail; impf. 3 pl. mid.-dep., unaugmented: ’they wailed’
ὀχήσονται: ὀχέω — carry, bear; pass. be carried; fut. 3 pl. mid. with passive sense: ’they will be carried’
ὄλωλας: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. and perf. perish; perf. 2 sg. ὄλωλας, intrans. with present force: ’you have perished’
ὄρεξας: ὀρέγω — stretch out, reach; aor. 2 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὤρεξας): ’you stretched out’
ὤλεο: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic ὤλου): ’you perished’
ῥίψει: ῥίπτω — hurl, throw; fut. 3 sg. act.: ’will hurl’
ῥυστάζεσκεν: ῥυστάζω — drag about, maltreat; iterative impf. 3 sg. in -σκ-, unaugmented: ’used to drag about’
ῥύσκευ: ῥύομαι — protect, defend, guard; iterative impf. 2 sg. mid. in -σκ-, epic -ευ for -ου, unaugmented: ’you used to guard’

__broaden__.λόχον: λόχος — ambush, band lying in wait; masc. acc. sg., goal of motion: ’to an ambush’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of εἷσαν: ’set an ambush’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of δείσητ’: ’fear an ambush’
__broaden__.πυκινὸν: πυκινός — thick, close-set, solid; masc. acc. sg.: ’solid’ · also masc. acc. sg., of a plot: ’close-woven, cunning’ (πυκινὸν δόλον ’a cunning trap’) · also neut. acc. sg., of a word: ’shrewd’ (πυκινὸν ἔπος ’a shrewd word’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with νέφος: ’dense’ (πυκινὸν νέφος ’dense cloud’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with λέχος: ’solid’ (πυκινὸν λέχος ’a solid bed’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with νόον: ’shrewd’ (πυκινὸν νόον ’shrewd mind’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἄχος: ’heavy, thick’ (πυκινὸν ἄχος ’heavy grief’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λόχον: ’solid, close-set (ambush)’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἔπος: ’solid’ (a word with weight)
__broaden__.πρῶται: πρῶτος — first; fem. nom. pl.: ’the first (hairs)’ · also fem. nom. pl., agreeing with νῆες: ’foremost (ships)’ · also fem. nom. pl., predicative, of the first to act: ’first (to …)’
__broaden__.δαῖτα: δαίς — feast, meal; fem. acc. sg.: ’for the feast’ (after κατά), ’a meal’ (object of τετύκοντο) · also fem. acc. sg., object of δαίνυ (’give a feast’) and of τίθει (’set a feast’) · also fem. acc. sg., cognate object of δαίνυντ’ (mid.): ’feasted a feast’
